# WB20 · Đặt lịch hẹn · ngày giờ không hợp lệ

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/schedule`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-data.js#validate`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `operations-ui.js › handle()` runs `O.validate(...)` (operations-data.js) on submit and writes the thrown message into `#ops-error` under the form; the dialog stays open and nothing is saved. The date is empty or before the demo day, or the duration or buffer is out of range (15–180 min, buffer 0–60 min); reached with the date cleared.
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"new\"]"} → {"wait":"#booking-form"} → {"setValue":["#booking-date",""]} → {"click":"#booking-form [type=submit]"}; it must show "Ngày, giờ hoặc thời lượng không hợp lệ.".

## Layout (top to bottom, from the web canvas frame, region → src/ui component)
Generated from the blocks of `Pema Web redesign canvas/Pema Web.dc.html` (frame WB20): every block is one kit component or web block (see BLOCKS.md). Names, numbers and money are the canvas sample data; labels, actions, statuses, filters and notices are the old web's, verbatim. The old web's own tree is under "Old web snapshot".
```tsx
// opens over the page "Hôm nay" (dimmed); the page behind it is not part of this screen
<Dialog eyebrow="Pema · vận hành" title="Đặt lịch hẹn" width="720px">
  <Dialog.Close aria-label="Đóng hộp thoại" icon="close">"×"</Dialog.Close>
  <Field label="Bệnh nhân" type="select" default="Nguyễn Thu Hà" options={["Nguyễn Thu Hà","Trần Minh Anh","Lê Hoàng Yến","Phạm Quốc Bảo","Võ Ngọc Trâm","Đặng Gia Linh","Bùi Khánh Vy","Hồ Thanh Tùng"]} />
  <Grid cols="repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))" gap="16px">
    <Field label="Dịch vụ" type="select" default="Tái khám & đánh giá" options={["Tái khám & đánh giá","Tư vấn da liễu","Laser theo chỉ định","Chăm sóc theo chỉ định"]} />
    <Field label="Bác sĩ" type="select" default="BS. Tâm" options={["BS. Tâm","BS. Mai","BS. An","BS. Lan"]} />
    <Field label="Phòng" type="select" default="Khám da liễu" options={["Khám da liễu","Tư vấn chuyên sâu","Laser & thủ thuật","Chăm sóc da"]} />
    <Field label="Ngày" type="date" placeholder="mm/dd/yyyy" />
    <Field label="Giờ" type="time" default="10:00" />
    <Field label="Ghi chú" type="text" />
  </Grid>
  <Notice tone="info" text="30 phút điều trị + 0 phút chuẩn bị · 300.000 ₫" />
  <Row gap="8px" wrap>
    <Button variant="primary">"Xác nhận đặt lịch"</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary">"Tìm giờ trống"</Button>
  </Row>
  <Notice tone="danger" role="alert" old="error-line">"Ngày, giờ hoặc thời lượng không hợp lệ."</Notice>
</Dialog>
```
Kit components used: Field×7, Button×2, Dialog×1; shared pieces: Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
